metaTitle: Custom Etched Shot Glasses | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched shot glasses for your next event. Perfect for giveaways and corporate gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Etched shot glasses offer a premium, permanent decoration that stands out from standard screen-printed designs. The frosted, engraved look adds a sophisticated touch, making them ideal for corporate gifts, bar promotions, or event souvenirs. Unlike printed logos, etching won't fade or peel over time, ensuring your brand remains visible through countless uses. Choose from clear or colored glass bases to match your company colors.
heroAltText: Custom etched shot glasses with engraved logo, perfect for corporate gifts and promotional events.
